name: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Limited
sector: Healthcare / Pharmaceuticals — generics, branded generics, APIs (India)
moat_justification: Diversified generics scale, an India branded franchise and the acquired Haleon nicotine-replacement brands give moderate staying power, and filing-direct ROIC ran 14.5-17.9% in FY23-25 with gross margins near 58%; but commodity US generics carry no durable pricing power, the high-margin lenalidomide contribution collapsed when US volume limits ended on 31 Jan 2026, and FY26/Q1 FY27 prints show ROIC and margins resetting sharply lower — a weak-to-moderate moat, not a durable one.
moat_for: Scale diversified generics platform: Global Generics across North America, India, emerging markets and Europe, plus the PSAI/API business
India branded-generics franchise compounding at mid-teens (FY26 India revenue +16%) with repeat-prescription brand equity
Acquired Haleon nicotine-replacement portfolio (Sep 2024) added owned consumer brands and drove Europe revenue +55% in FY26
Filing-direct economics through FY25: ROIC proxy 17.9%/17.9%/14.5% in FY23/24/25 and gross margin 56.7%/58.6%/58.5%
Development pipeline as an intangible asset: 73 ANDAs pending at Q1 FY26 (43 Paragraph IV, 22 possible first-to-file), semaglutide and abatacept optionality
moat_against: No pricing power in commodity US generics: structural price erosion, and lenalidomide — the outsized profit driver — lost its protected volume window on 31 Jan 2026; North America revenue fell 22% in FY26 and NA generics fell 41% YoY in Q1 FY27
Earnings reset is already in the prints: FY26 PAT down ~24% YoY, Q4 FY26 PAT down 86% YoY, Q1 FY27 PAT down ~69% YoY with EBITDA margin 12.5% vs 26.7% a year earlier
Single-product concentration was real: the lenalidomide shelf-stock adjustment alone cut FY26 revenue by Rs4,530M
USFDA manufacturing-compliance overhang (e.g. Form 483 with seven observations at the CTO-2 API facility in Nov 2024) can strand supply and approvals
ROIC is falling, not through-cycle stable: FY25 14.5% on filed figures and materially lower on FY26/Q1 FY27 reported results
one_liner: Solid diversified generics franchise in an earnings reset, moat 4/10 — does not clear 15%: weighted IRR 4.6% and IV@15% $2.19 vs the $12.87 ADS price; it would need to trade near $2.19 to clear the 15% hurdle on these scenarios.

ads_ratio.source: Dr. Reddy's Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2024: 'One ADS represents one equity share of Rs.5 par value per share'; the 5-for-1 share sub-division effective 28 Oct 2024 left the ratio unchanged — the company's FY2026 interim/annual share-capital disclosure states each ADS continues to represent one underlying equity share and the number of ADSs increased proportionately (FY2026 Form 20-F, period ended 2026-03-31, filed 2026-05-29). Depositary listing (Deutsche Bank ADR universe) confirms Ratio (ORD:DR) 1:1.
ads_ratio.reason: 20-F filer: EDGAR share counts are ordinary equity shares and the Nasdaq/NYSE price is per ADS; with a 1:1 ratio per-ADS figures equal per-ordinary-share figures, so no scaling applies — the ratio is declared to clear the ADS_RATIO_MISSING gate on the filer's own statement.
